thread:
Ashley (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — I got asked to clarify actual ship windows for the API, Console refactor, and Optimize. Can product give concrete quarters and any hard blockers?

David (VP Product): Short version: API streaming + enhanced quotas planned for Q3, Console refactor planned for Q4, Optimize early access late Q3 with GA in Q4. I'll call out major risks below.

Maria (PM - API): For API specifics: streaming-v2 + per-route quota controls target ship window Jul 15 (Q3). We'll do a one-week canary starting ~Jul 10. If anyone needs an earlier canary for a partner, DM me.

Kai (Eng - Runtime): Implementation note: streaming-v2 depends on kernel X merge and end-to-end perf validation. If kernel lands late we'll be looking at ~2wk slip. Tracking in PR #542.

Jordan (DevRel): For integrators: will existing API keys and SDKs remain compatible? Any breaking changes? @Maria

Maria (PM - API): No breaking changes. Minor SDK bumps for helpers; we will publish a migration guide + sample snippets.

Nina (Product Ops): Console refactor: aiming for Oct window (Q4) for new nav + per-route dashboards. We plan a dark launch in Sept (opt-in orgs) to surface UX issues early.

Ashley (CEO): Can Marketing make Optimize early access signup public before the end of Q3? They need ~3w lead for materials.

David (VP Product): Yes — target Aug 1 for public signup. Beta will be limited (~50 orgs) so we can iterate.

Kai (Eng - Runtime): Question: will Dedicated customers get Optimize autosuggest & quantization recommendations at GA? @David

David (VP Product): Hosted + Dedicated get full Optimize GA features. Private (VPC/on-prem) will follow after compliance sign-off — tentatively Q1 next year.

Jordan (DevRel): Request: can we share example prompts and estimated cost-savings for the launch post? Marketing wants concrete numbers. @Maria @David

Maria (PM - API): We'll put together a one-pager: typical chat workload with batching + KV cache => 20–40% token cost reduction (depends on prompt shape). We'll anonymize benchmarks and include config examples.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: streaming-v2-canary -> 2026-07-10T04:00Z

Kai (Eng - Runtime): Ops caveat: if kernel X shows perf regressions on A100 in canary, fallback is to pin older kernel on that fleet and re-run perf sweep. We'll surface perf numbers ASAP.

Nina (Product Ops): Action items I captured: Maria -> migration guide draft by 2026-06-30; David -> confirm Dedicated timeline with infra by 2026-06-25; Jordan -> coordinate launch blog and case studies by 2026-07-20.

Ashley (CEO): Appreciate the clarity. If any team needs temporary velocity support (engineer time) to hit these dates, ping me privately.

Maria (PM - API): Ack — adding canary org list now.

Kai (Eng - Runtime): +1 to dates; will flag kernel risk immediately if we see it.

Jordan (DevRel): I'll spin up the early access doc and a signup form, link when ready.

Nina (Product Ops): Noted and will schedule the dark-launch QA window. :white_check_mark:

Ashley (CEO): Closing this thread — keep progress in the shared roadmap doc and bring any escalations to next week's leadership sync.
